title: PreciseCoder: Faithful and Generalizable Debugging Beyond Unit-Test Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2610.18755v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) from unit tests is the common recipe for post-training code models, but a unit test only asks whether the final program passes. We analyze what this unit-test-only reward teaches a model during debugging and find that, while it raises pass rates, it also teaches the model to edit more and to hallucinate bugs in code that is already correct. We introduce PreciseCoder, a training algorithm that augments the unit-test reward with a signal for semantically verified, localized edits, which correlates with smaller edits and higher pass rates. On 4B, 9B, and 27B models, PreciseCoder reduces the average number of edit lines from 7-15to 3 at a pass rate on par with unit-test-only training. Trained only on single-line bugs, PreciseCoder can generalize to repository-level program repair, where it resolves more issues with smaller patches. translated_title: PreciseCoder：超越单元测试奖励的忠实且可泛化的调试
translated_abstract: 基于单元测试的强化学习（RL）是代码模型后训练的常用配方，但单元测试只关心最终程序能否通过。我们分析了这种仅依赖单元测试的奖励在调试过程中教给模型什么，发现它在提高通过率的同时，也教会了模型进行更多编辑，并在原本正确的代码中臆造出错误（幻觉性bug）。我们提出PreciseCoder，这是一种训练算法，它在单元测试奖励的基础上增加了一个针对经过语义验证的局部化编辑的信号，该信号与更小的编辑量和更高的通过率相关。在4B、9B和27B模型上，PreciseCoder将平均编辑行数从7-15行减少到3行，同时通过率与仅使用单元测试训练的模型持平。仅在单行错误上训练的PreciseCoder能够泛化到仓库级别的程序修复任务，在其中以更小的补丁解决了更多问题。其精确性还能从较弱的模型迁移到较强的模型：给定推理（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: PreciseCoder在单元测试奖励之外引入经语义验证的局部化编辑信号，使模型在保持通过率的同时将平均编辑量从7-15行降至3行，并能泛化到仓库级程序修复，以更小补丁解决更多问题。
en_tdlr: PreciseCoder augments unit-test rewards with a signal for semantically verified, localized edits, reducing average edit lines from 7-15 to 3 at comparable pass rates and generalizing to repository-level program repair with smaller patches and more resolved issues.
